LanguageData.CC_Settings_WorldSituations_Tip: Rare happenings across the whole region that last from a few days to a month: a plague or a famine among the neighbors, a warlord rising among a hostile people, a chief's death and the fight over the seat, a town founded or abandoned, a great fair, a hard winter. While one lasts, it changes which events come (fewer caravans in a plague year, more raids from the warlord's people), puts questions to the council, and ends in a way that depends on what the colony did. At most two run at the same time. They come on Rimfolk's own slow rhythm, apart from the storyteller. The council's World page shows what's going on. Dev mode can start any of them (Debug actions, Rimfolk).
LanguageData.CC_Settings_DaysBetweenWorldSituations: About one world event every {0} days
LanguageData.CC_Settings_DaysBetweenWorldSituations_T: On average; it varies by a third either way, and the first comes sooner. Each world event also waits a long while before it can come again.
